camp_state.trace: tools/turn_trace.mjs stores Game_API_Camp_GetState as cp.awake raw integer
camp_state.extractor: tools/fish/ex_turns.mjs uses if c.awake as boolean

ward_distance.extractor: tools/fish/ex_events.mjs subtracts turn-start self.x/y for every Place ward event

engagement_features.extractor: tools/fish/ex_engage.mjs selects actual hit target for positive open labels, nearest enemy for negatives
engagement_features.implication: e_* features are target-dependent and not a uniform pre-decision state feature; causal or deployable engagement thresholds need separate validation

camp_model_split.actual_default: 20% split by decision index hash, not game ID
camp_model_split.implication: same-match decisions can occur in training and test; blanket game-CV claim is inaccurate
